subject: Success with Google Analytics in flexdashboard?

messages.author: 679d1df1e5fec530
messages.subject: Success with Google Analytics in flexdashboard?
parts:
Hello, 

I've been trying to deploy Google Analytics on my shiny.io app. The guide for doing so (http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/google-analytics.html) has steps for a regular shiny app--not a flexdashbaord.  

I can follow the guide up until putting the "googl-analytics.js" file into Rmarkdown. 

    I've put      tags$head(includeScript("google-analytics.js"))    all throughout the code, but I'll either get knitting errors, or the script will not show when I open in a browser and view the source code. 

I tried to find help on github, but most posts references Rmarkdown as a visualization tool for google analytics -- not embedding google analytics tracker in the code. 

Has anyone had success using google analytics on their flexdashbaord? 


Thank you, 

John
